title: Reading — Six Words, Six Lines, and a First Paragraph
label: ch:ur-pehla-sabaq
canDo: I can read Urdu words cold, read a meeting in the order it happens, and hold a whole paragraph without translating it word by word.

payoff.summary: Fifty-one words of Urdu in a row with no new word in them, carried by the one sentence shape the book has taught most: something is something, with ہے last.
